collection.description: An elder wants to attend a ceremony up a steep path, but their balance has worsened.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: An elder wants to attend a ceremony up a steep path, but their balance has worsened.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: Villagers add handholds; the route becomes safer for children and injured workers too.

text_only.reason: the path is safer for anyone hurt; nobody is hurt now

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The elder accepts a walking companion and sets the pace.

c.name: Answer C
c.text: The community brings the music downhill; the elder still chooses which portions to attend.
